name: Construction Management + Svc (Sub-con, Third Party Cost, Local Authorities etc)
description: Sabah-specific evidence for EPCC/construction-management scope and the statutory framework. No published schedule of construction-management, subcontract or local-authority fees for this 7-unit plant was found; figures below are the total project and statutory charges only, not a priced indirect line item.
aliases: Construction Management + Svc (Sub-con, Third Party Cost, Local Authorities etc)

specifications.metric: CTCI Corporation / Synerlitz Sdn Bhd / — EPCC construction period
specifications.basis: Daily Express, published 24 May 2011: Kimanis Power Sdn Bhd 300 MW combined-cycle plant; EPCC contract signed with consortium CTCI Corporation (Taiwan), Synerlitz Sdn Bhd and SCHB Engineering Services (Suria Capital subsidiary); consortium to develop, construct and commission plant and related facilities/infrastructures; package within 32 months from 1 Apr 2011 to first commercial operation 1 Dec

specifications.metric: Sabah Electricity Sdn Bhd / Energy Com — fast-track gas turbine capacity
specifications.basis: Borneo Post, posted 25 September 2024: SESB received Letter of Notification from Energy Commission of Sabah for supply and installation of 94 MW gas turbine generators at Kimanis; injection point at Langsat Main Intake Substation (PMU); completion expected June 2025.

gaps.what: Construction Management + Svc (Sub-con, Third Party Cost, Local Authorities etc)
gaps.why: No public document publishes a construction-management fee, subcontract third-party cost schedule, or Sabah local-authority fee schedule for this 7-unit project. The RM1.5 billion figure is a whole-plant capital sum with no indirect breakdown.
gaps.next_action: Obtain the bidder's priced BOQ and the relevant Sabah local-authority fee schedule; do not derive an indirect percentage from the RM1.5 billion total.

notes: WBS/BOQ line item from research/alaska-geg-wbs/alaska_breakdown.txt (5/6/7 Construction indirect, commissioning, EPC indirect).
